groups.description: Bags and cases for commuting, shopping, school, and travel with luggage; not technical outdoor equipment.

children.description: An everyday backpack with a padded compartment for a laptop.
A close-fitting padded sleeve protecting a laptop inside another bag.
An open or zip-top reusable bag carried by handles for shopping.
A rigid or soft travel case with wheels and a telescoping handle.
A small zippered fabric organizer for clothes inside luggage.
A cross-body shoulder bag with a flap for everyday work or school.

groups.description: Equipment designed for hiking, camping, and carrying supplies outdoors.

children.description: A trail backpack with load support, a hip belt, or hydration-system features.
A waterproof roll-top sack that keeps equipment dry while paddling or hiking.
An insulated sleeping enclosure for overnight camping.
A portable outdoor shelter held up by poles.
A portable fuel-burning cooker for outdoor meals.
Handheld adjustable poles that support walking on trails.

groups.description: Powered electronic devices and accessories for charging, connectivity, and sound.

children.description: A rechargeable battery that charges other devices without a wall outlet.
An adapter plugged into a mains socket to charge a phone or computer.
An adapter that expands a computer port into several data or display ports.
Battery-powered headphones using a wireless audio connection.
A standalone loudspeaker receiving audio over Bluetooth.
A networking device that distributes an internet connection over Wi-Fi.

groups.description: Household containers, furnishings, cleaning accessories, and tools specifically for food preparation.

children.description: A reusable lidded container for storing meals and leftovers.
A reusable drinking vessel with a narrow opening or drinking lid.
An open household basket for organizing belongings on a shelf or floor.
A fabric sack for collecting or washing clothes, including delicates.
A household scale used to weigh ingredients for cooking or baking, including digital scales.
A flat kitchen surface used under food while chopping.

cases.text: A 20-litre city pack with two shoulder straps, padded 15-inch computer pocket, and space for office papers.
A slim neoprene zip pouch fits tightly around a 13-inch notebook computer. No straps or extra storage.
Cabin luggage with four spinner wheels, a telescoping handle, and a rigid shell.
A 30-litre daypack with an internal frame, load-bearing hip belt, hydration-bladder sleeve, and rain cover for mountain walks.
A ten-litre sack with welded seams and a roll-and-clip closure keeps spare clothes dry on a kayak.
A folding burner screws onto a gas canister and supports a cooking pot at a campsite.
A pocket-sized rechargeable 20,000 mAh battery with USB-C output recharges a phone away from sockets.
A bus-powered USB-C adapter adds HDMI, Ethernet, and three USB data ports to a notebook.
Over-ear Bluetooth cans with noise cancellation and a rechargeable battery, supplied with a carry pouch.
A leak-resistant lidded box for leftovers or a packed meal; suitable for fridge storage.
A zippered mesh sack keeps delicate clothes together inside the washing machine; also useful in a suitcase.
A battery-powered digital platform measures flour and sugar in grams while baking.
